title: Il y a — there is/there are (set 5: at school)

exercises.en: There is a teacher in the classroom.
exercises.fr: Il y a un professeur dans la salle de classe.

exercises.en: There are desks in the room.
exercises.fr: Il y a des bureaux dans la salle.

exercises.en: There is a board at the front.
exercises.fr: Il y a un tableau devant.

exercises.en: There are books in the bag.
exercises.fr: Il y a des livres dans le sac.

exercises.en: There is a library at the school.
exercises.fr: Il y a une bibliothèque à l'école.

exercises.en: There are many students in the hallway.
exercises.fr: Il y a beaucoup d'étudiants dans le couloir.

exercises.en: There is a computer in the classroom.
exercises.fr: Il y a un ordinateur dans la salle de classe.

exercises.en: There are pencils on the desk.
exercises.fr: Il y a des crayons sur le bureau.

exercises.en: There is a clock on the wall.
exercises.fr: Il y a une horloge sur le mur.

exercises.en: There are chairs around the table.
exercises.fr: Il y a des chaises autour de la table.
